countries.name: Benin
countries.capitalNote: Porto-Novo is the official capital; Cotonou is the seat of government.

countries.name: Bolivia
countries.capitalNote: Sucre is the constitutional capital; La Paz is the seat of government.

countries.name: Côte d'Ivoire
countries.capitalNote: Yamoussoukro is the official capital; Abidjan is the economic capital.

countries.name: Eswatini
countries.capitalNote: Mbabane is the administrative capital; Lobamba is the royal and legislative capital.

countries.name: Israel
countries.capitalNote: Jerusalem is the proclaimed capital; most embassies are in Tel Aviv.

countries.name: Malaysia
countries.capitalNote: Kuala Lumpur is the official capital; Putrajaya is the administrative centre.

countries.name: Netherlands
countries.capitalNote: Amsterdam is the constitutional capital; the government sits in The Hague.

countries.name: Palestine
countries.capitalNote: Ramallah is the administrative centre; East Jerusalem is the proclaimed capital.

countries.name: South Africa
countries.capitalNote: Pretoria is the executive capital; Cape Town is the legislative capital and Bloemfontein the judicial capital.

countries.name: Sri Lanka
countries.capitalNote: Sri Jayawardenepura Kotte is the official capital; Colombo is the commercial capital.

countries.name: Tanzania
countries.capitalNote: Dodoma is the official capital; Dar es Salaam is the largest city and former capital.
